sentence: The room's build, move and contest restate in the model's terms, but t05 and its unused concepts c0027, c0028 and c0036 carry host-guest organizing—being asked off the bi flag's territory and seeking a group with unused space—that the model lacks.

The room's organizing can be restated in the model's terms — a starter's proposal and calls for hands (R01/P01), a recognizable mark settled and a template circulated (P02/P04), build reports and bare joins (P03/P15), a move off the bi flag and neighbour talk with tagpro (P10/P08/P09/P18/P07), host-sub April-Fools play (K01), and marking, recording and mourning at the close (P11/P12) — and none of the unused concepts, including the suggestion to ask a group with unused space (c0036) or the tagpro taunts (c0042, c0050), shows organizing the model lacks or contradicts a standing element or arrow.
